# Connecting biological mechanisms to therapeutic decisions

<p class="hero-subtitle">
I am Rebeca Oliveira, a biomedical engineer and computational scientist
at Johns Hopkins University. I build mechanistic and data-informed models
to investigate how biological systems, patient heterogeneity, and drug
mechanisms shape treatment response.
</p>

<p class="hero-subtitle">
I am particularly interested in models that do more than reproduce data:
models that help explain why a treatment works, for whom, and under which
biological conditions.
</p>

<p class="hero-fields">
Quantitative Systems Pharmacology · Pharmacometrics · Systems Biology
</p>

## What I am exploring now

::: {.project-card}

### Natural Products and Translational Modeling

I am expanding my quantitative pharmacology work toward natural products,
medicinal plants, and complex biological interventions. My goal is to connect
traditional therapeutic knowledge with mechanistic pharmacology, systems
biology, and modern drug-development methods.
